name: tic-tac-toe
description: An advanced, responsive desktop Tic-Tac-Toe game built with **Java 23** and **JavaFX 22**, adhering to clean desktop UI principles (crisp 4px/6px geometry, no purple gradients, and zero AI-slop design).

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','game.js','manifest.json','favicon.svg','icon-192.png','icon-512.png','privacy.html','terms.html','sw.js','screenshot-mobile.png','screenshot-desktop.png'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f); });" && npx cap copy android
